findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice long questions for Unit 13 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 24 questions numbered 1-24; by section: 13.1 1, 13.2 1, 13.2.1 1, 13.3.1 1, 13.3.2 4, 13.4 2, 13.5 2, 13.6 7, 13.7 5.

The unit's proofs (power rule for positive and negative integers, constant multiple, sum, product and quotient rules, |x| continuous but not differentiable at 0) and the main problem types (tangent by the limit, average and instantaneous velocity, first principles for polynomial, root and fraction functions, the rules of 13.6, profit, motion, cost, investment and stress). Functions and numbers are our own; every step and final answer was checked by computation in Python (sympy, check13_long.py). Book corrections followed: secant line, f'(0) and dx -> 0+ for |x|, the minimizing radius from r cubed (cube root gives r).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
